name: Joy Division

whyMatters.en: Salford/Manchester post-punk four-piece formed in 1976. Unknown Pleasures (1979) and Closer (1980) fix Hook’s high melodic bass, Morris’s spaced drums, and Martin Hannett’s production before Curtis’s death ended the band.
whyMatters.zh: 索尔福德/曼彻斯特后朋克四人组，1976 年成立。《Unknown Pleasures》（1979）与《Closer》（1980）定下 Hook 高音旋律贝斯、Morris 宽空间鼓点与 Martin Hannett 制作；Curtis 去世后乐队结束。

note.en: Single with a clear Hook bass hook and Curtis vocal.
note.zh: 单曲；Hook 贝斯钩子与 Curtis 人声清楚。

note.en: 1980 single; mid-tempo; Hannett production; widest public entry.
note.zh: 1980 单曲；中速；Hannett 制作；公众入口最宽。

interviewQuotes.text: I used to think of myself as an artist.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Ian Curtis

interviewQuotes.text: The space between the notes was the atmosphere.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Bernard Sumner

lyricQuotes: Love will tear us apart again

shortBio.en: Salford post-punk, 1976–80. Curtis, Sumner, Hook, Morris; Factory with Hannett. Love Will Tear Us Apart is the main single reference.
shortBio.zh: 索尔福德后朋克，1976–80。Curtis、Sumner、Hook、Morris；Factory，Hannett 制作。《Love Will Tear Us Apart》是主要单曲参照。

body.en: Manchester post-punk, 1976–1980 (earlier as Warsaw). Ian Curtis, Bernard Sumner, Peter Hook, Stephen Morris. Martin Hannett produced Unknown Pleasures (1979). Curtis died in May 1980 before a US tour and Closer’s release; Love Will Tear Us Apart followed as the best-known single. Three-quarters of the band continued as New Order.
body.zh: 曼彻斯特后朋克，1976–1980（早期称 Warsaw）。Ian Curtis、Bernard Sumner、Peter Hook、Stephen Morris。Martin Hannett 制作《Unknown Pleasures》（1979）。Curtis 于 1980 年 5 月在美国巡演与《Closer》发行前去世；《Love Will Tear Us Apart》成为最知名单曲。四分之三成员继续为 New Order。

body.en: Space, bass, and Curtis’s vocal sit at the center. Hannett’s drum and instrument treatment, Hook later said, put the gloom into the record.
body.zh: 空间感、贝斯与 Curtis 的人声是核心。Hook 后来说，Hannett 对鼓与乐器的处理把阴郁写进了唱片。

alt.en: Peter Hook of Joy Division and New Order, East Finchley
alt.zh: Joy Division / New Order 的 Peter Hook，东芬奇利

body.en:
1979 single: Hook bass hook, Curtis vocal, clearer melodic line than many album cuts.

Useful entry before the 1980 singles.
body.zh:
1979 单曲：Hook 贝斯钩子、Curtis 人声，旋律线比许多专辑曲更清楚。

可作进入 1980 年单曲前的入口。

body.en: Love Will Tear Us Apart (1980) remains the single most cited Joy Division track. Closer was finished around Curtis’s death and the cancelled US dates.
body.zh: 《Love Will Tear Us Apart》（1980）仍是被引用最多的 Joy Division 单曲。《Closer》完成于 Curtis 去世与取消的美国巡演前后。

body.en: The book compares the doubt after Curtis to The Doors after Morrison. Sumner took vocals; Gillian Gilbert added keys. New Order’s singles path (Temptation, Blue Monday) sits on the same Factory/Saville visual world and the Hacienda club.
body.zh: 书中把 Curtis 去世后的不确定，比作 Morrison 离开后的 The Doors。Sumner 改主唱；Gillian Gilbert 加入键盘。New Order 的单曲线（《Temptation》《Blue Monday》）仍在 Factory／Saville 视觉与 Hacienda 俱乐部同一语境里。

body.en:
Contemporary interview material is limited; later oral history fills gaps. Prefer musical description over romantic fatalism.

Start with the Factory records.
body.zh:
同时代访谈材料有限；后来口述史补缺。优先音乐描述，少取浪漫宿命论。

从 Factory 唱片入手。

note.en: 1980 single; Hook bass and Hannett mix as the widest public entry.
note.zh: 1980 单曲；Hook 贝斯与 Hannett 混音是最宽公众入口。

note.en: High melodic bass, spaced drums, dry baritone vocal.
note.zh: 高音旋律贝斯、宽空间鼓点、干男中音人声。

note.en: Hook high bass and Morris drums; Curtis baritone center. Factory albums with Hannett.
note.zh: Hook 高音贝斯与 Morris 鼓；Curtis 男中音中心。Factory 专辑，Hannett 制作。
